_meta.name: Warli grammar rules (seed)
_meta.description: Rule-based grammar layer applied after dictionary lookup: word-order reordering, simple inflection/affixation, and postposition mapping. Derived from the lipi/pronunciation research papers (data/research_papers/). Editable without touching Python.
_meta.status: SEED. Refine against the two Warli research papers once added.

word_order._comment: Warli, like Marathi/Hindi, is predominantly SOV (subject-object-verb). The reoderer moves a trailing verb to the end and keeps the subject first.

inflections._comment: Simple suffixes keyed by a coarse grammatical feature. Applied to the Warli verb/noun token when the matching source cue is detected.

postpositions._comment: English/Hindi relational words mapped to Warli postpositions (Warli uses postpositions, not prepositions).
